title: Headless TTW Latchkey Kenny (DLC04FF04): from Kenny's hideout through Kenny-Bear fetched from the shaft to the hideout given to the player (stage 100; the quest has no completing stage)

actions.text: Given: the player out of Vault 101 (MQ01 10), across to Point Lookout with The Local Flavor done (DLC04MQ01 200: its chain), standing on Point Lookout's landing (where the voyage puts the player [observed]). Latchkey Kenny (DLC04FF04) runs from the start [observed].

Path: Kenny in his hideout under the Lady of Rosary church (his first greeting, then DLC04FF04Hideout, HideoutTeddy, HideoutTeddyAgree: FetchTeddy 1), Kenny-Bear picked up at the bottom of the shaft (DLC04FF04teddyScript's OnAdd: FetchTeddy 2), and the bear given back (DLC04FF04Teddy: stage 100, the player may move into the hideout; DLC04FF04TeddyMoveIn2 to end the talk). The games of tag and hide-and-seek after (150 to 162) are left out.
Travel stand-in: through the trapped tunnels to Kenny's hideout.

actions.label: kenny: you made it past my traps?

actions.text: Travel stand-in: back through the mine to the bottom of the big shaft, where Kenny-Bear lies: DLC04FF04KennyBearActivator in DLC04Mine03, whose script gives the player Kenny-Bear (DLC04FF04KennyBear) and disables itself; its OnAdd (DLC04FF04teddyScript) sets FetchTeddy 2 [observed: SCPT 0x0E00ED91, 0x0E00886B]. The two placed DLC04FF04KennyBear references lie in test cells (DLC04zTestJoel, DLC04zTestMarkiepoo) no player reaches [observed: fnvtool world refs].

DLC04FF04 has no stage flagged Complete Quest and none of its scripts completes it (it stays running for the games with Kenny) [observed: its QSDT flags]; 100, the hideout given, is its last stage on this path.
